evidence: Caes. BC 2.25: quā prōnūntiātiōne factā (Lewis & Short)
Val. Max. 4.8.5, of a crier (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: What is announced aloud to all, as by a crier; also a judge’s verdict, and in rhetoric a speaker’s delivery (its commonest sense in Quintilian). The verb is prōnūntiāre (see announce, under nūntiāre).

terms.gloss: an official notice, a proclamation, an edict
terms.comment: An announcement put up in writing by someone in authority: the magistrate’s edict, above all the praetor’s. For a notice from a council, a school or a company.

phrases.english: Did you hear what was announced?

sources: Lewis & Short: pronuntiatio · Lewis & Short: pronuntio · Lewis & Short: edictum
